children: Australian shares were likely to lose ground at open on Thursday, potentially extending declines to a third session as oil-fuelled inflation fears kept investor risk appetite in check.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 1%, a 95.4-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark lost 0.1% on Wednesday.
